// D-12 P3 (DL-167): the API returns imsi masked; expect what it returns, not what was sent.

const maskImsi = d => { if (d.imsi === undefined) return d; const p = (d.plmn && d.imsi.startsWith(d.plmn)) ? d.plmn.length : 5; const s = d.imsi.length - p; const tail = s >= 8 ? 4 : 0; d.imsi = s < 4 ? "*".repeat(d.imsi.length) : d.imsi.slice(0, p) + "*".repeat(s - tail) + d.imsi.slice(d.imsi.length - tail); return d; };
pm.test("body trace id matches response header", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().traceId).to.eql(pm.response.headers.get("X-Trace-Id")));

exec: pm.test("all 25 queues exist", () => expected.forEach(name => pm.expect(byName, name).to.have.property(name)));

pm.test("all queues are durable quorum queues", () => expected.forEach(name => { pm.expect(byName[name].durable, name).to.eql(true); pm.expect(byName[name].arguments["x-queue-type"], name).to.eql("quorum"); }));
pm.test("each main queue has a consumer", () => types.forEach(type => pm.expect(byName["app_statsstore." + type].consumers, type).to.be.above(0)));
pm.test("main queues drained", () => types.forEach(type => pm.expect(byName["app_statsstore." + type].messages, type).to.eql(0)));
pm.test("DLQs stayed empty", () => types.forEach(type => pm.expect(byName["app_statsstore." + type + ".dlq"].messages, type).to.eql(0)));
